listing.name: flOw — flOw static recompilation (sp00nznet)
listing.summary: Upstream reports drawing an engine test scene. Normal title-screen startup is blocked, and full gameplay remains in development. Follow the setup instructions below. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own PlayStation Network NPUA80001 PKG, RAP and decrypted EBOOT, plus your own libsre firmware for low-level emulation. The required revision is unspecified; check upstream before preparing files.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow the upstream instructions to translate the game locally and build it from source.

warnings: Upstream reports drawing an engine test scene. Normal title-screen startup is blocked, and full gameplay remains in development.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.
